title: ProofOfParticipation
tagline: Prove you were in Cannes for the event with your mobile and mint a NFT
description:
How can you prove that you took part in an event without revealing everything about yourself? Thanks to zero knowledge and your mobile, it's possible.

Proof of Participation retrieves your GPS position with your consent, and allows you to generate an NFT if you're at the Palais des Congrès.
how_its_made:
This project uses mopro, a mobile framework for fast zk proof generation, the mobile app use react native and was built for iOS,, we use reown for wallet connection.
Also we use noir to generate proof, the mantle blockchain for NFT generation and proof validation, and hardhat to create and test smartcontracts.
